summary: Caller claims to be Chase security and says the user's account is compromised. Asks the user to read out the 6-digit code that just arrived on their phone — no bank ever asks for this on an inbound call.
recommended_actions: Call Chase on the number printed on the back of your card
Do NOT share the OTP you just received

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: This is the fraud department at Chase Bank. Your account was flagged for suspicious activity right now.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: We need to verify it's really you. I just sent a 6-digit code to your phone, can you read that code to me?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Thank you. I'm locking your other accounts now. Don't tell anyone about this process.
